info.name: RentCheck REST Account Settings Inspections V2 API

params.name: search
params.description: Search string to match in several inspection's fields

params.name: page_number
params.description: The page number of the collection. Zero-indexed.

params.name: page_size
params.description: The number of elements in the data collection.

params.name: sort_by
params.description:
Sort results by one of the available fields. `approved_date` sorts by
the approved date, falling back to the completed date when there is no
approval.

params.name: sort_type
params.description:
Sort direction. Accepted case-insensitively — any casing of `asc` /
`desc` is silently normalised to `ASC` / `DESC`.

params.name: inspection_status[]
params.description: List of inspection statuses to filter inspections. Prefer `filters[inspection_status][value]`.

params.name: inspection_template[]
params.description: List of inspection template ids to filter inspections. Prefer `filters[inspection_template][value]`.

params.name: team_id[]
params.description: List of teams id to filter inspections. Prefer `filters[team][value]`.

params.name: assigned_to[]
params.description: List of user ids to filter inspections. Prefer `filters[assigned_to][value]`.

params.name: ratings[]
params.description: List of feature ratings to filter inspections by. Prefer `filters[rating][value]`.

params.name: property_id[]
params.description: List of property ids to filter inspections by. Prefer `filters[property][value]`.

params.name: archived
params.description: Filter inspections by their archived status. Prefer `filters[archived]`.

params.name: start_due_date
params.description: Value to filter inspection date by a starting date. `yyyy-mm-dd` format. The legacy parameter is forwarded onto `filters[due_date][start_date]`. Prefer `filters[due_date][start_date]`.

params.name: end_due_date
params.description: Value to filter inspection date by a ending date. `yyyy-mm-dd` format. Prefer `filters[due_date][end_date]`.

params.name: start_completed_date
params.description: Value to filter completed inspection date by a starting date. `yyyy-mm-dd` format. Prefer `filters[completed_date][start_date]`.

params.name: end_completed_date
params.description: Value to filter completed inspection date by a ending date. `yyyy-mm-dd` format. Prefer `filters[completed_date][end_date]`.

params.name: filters[search]
params.description: Search string to match in several inspection's fields. Preferred over the legacy `search` parameter.

params.name: filters[archived]
params.description: Filter inspections by its archived status.

params.name: filters[has_flags]
params.description: Filter inspections by whether they have one or more maintenance flags. `true` returns only inspections with flags; `false` returns only inspections with none.

params.name: filters[inspection_template][value]
params.description: List of inspection templates to filter inspections. This parameter accepts multiple ids concatenated with a `|`.

params.name: filters[inspection_template][condition]
params.description: Condition to be used to filter by inspection templates.

params.name: filters[inspection_status][value]
params.description: Pipe-separated list of inspection statuses to filter by (e.g. `Not Started|In Review`).

params.name: filters[inspection_status][condition]
params.description: Condition to be used to filter by inspection status.

params.name: filters[team][value]
params.description: List of teams id to filter inspections. This parameter accepts multiple ids concatenated with a `|`.

params.name: filters[team][condition]
params.description: Condition to be used to filter by teams id.

params.name: filters[property][value]
params.description: List of properties id to filter inspections. This parameter accepts multiple ids concatenated with a `|`.

params.name: filters[property][condition]
params.description: Condition to be used to filter by properties id.

params.name: filters[rating][value]
params.description: List of inspection ratings to filter by. Multiple values are concatenated with `|` (e.g. `Good|Fair`). Allowed values, `Good`, `Fair`, `Poor`.

params.name: filters[rating][condition]
params.description: Condition to be used to filter by ratings.

params.name: filters[assigned_to][value]
params.description: List of user ids to filter inspections by. This parameter accepts multiple ids concatenated with a `|`.

params.name: filters[assigned_to][condition]
params.description: Condition to be used to filter by assigned to.

params.name: filters[review_step][value]
params.description: List of review steps to filter inspections by. Multiple values are concatenated with `|` (e.g. `Initial Review|Secondary Review`). Allowed values, `Initial Review`, `Secondary Review`.

params.name: filters[review_step][condition]
params.description: Condition to apply to the review step filter. The validator only accepts `any_of`.

params.name: filters[created_by][value]
params.description: List of creator ids to filter inspections by. This parameter accepts multiple values concatenated with a `|`.

params.name: filters[created_by][condition]
params.description: Condition to be used to filter by created by.

params.name: filters[due_date][start_date]
params.description:
Value to filter inspection effective due date by a starting date.
`yyyy-mm-dd` format.

params.name: filters[due_date][end_date]
params.description:
Value to filter inspection effective due date by a ending date.
`yyyy-mm-dd` format. `end_date` must be on or after `start_date`,
otherwise the response is `end date must be equal or after start date`.

params.name: filters[due_date_legacy][start_date]
params.description:
Value to filter inspection due date (pre-effective-due-date) by a starting date.
`yyyy-mm-dd` format. Cannot be combined with
`filters[due_date]`; that combination is rejected with
`You cannot use both due_date and due_date_legacy filters at the same time`.

params.name: filters[due_date_legacy][end_date]
params.description:
Value to filter inspection due date (pre-effective-due-date) by a ending date.
`yyyy-mm-dd` format. `end_date` must be on or after `start_date`, otherwise
the response is `end date must be equal or after start date`. See `start_date`
for the mutually-exclusive constraint with `filters[due_date]`.

params.name: filters[completed_date][start_date]
params.description:
Value to filter completed inspection date by a starting date.
`yyyy-mm-dd` format.

params.name: filters[completed_date][end_date]
params.description:
Value to filter completed inspection date by a ending date.
`yyyy-mm-dd` format. `end_date` must be on or after `start_date`, otherwise
the response is `end date must be equal or after start date`.

params.name: fields[]
params.description: Optional list of inspection fields to include in the response. When omitted, the default projection is returned. Internal use only.

params.name: include_full_template_info
params.description: When `true`, each inspection's `template` field is returned as the full template document instead of the default digest. Internal use only.

items.docs: Returns the list of users that have ever created an inspection the current user can see. Used to populate the `filters[created_by]` picker on the inspections list.
